topics.label: Introduction to inflammation mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation by connecting previously introduced immunological components.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage recognition mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how innate immune sensors identify molecular patterns of microbes and cellular injury to trigger intracellular inflammatory signaling.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment and inflammatory propagation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte trafficking and propagate inflammatory responses across local tissues and systemic circulation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation and tissue repair
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue regeneration, and sustain controlled chronic responses when clearance fails.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and previews the topic for the subsequent lecture.
